# automation

`AUTOMATED_BROWSER`: is this page driven by automation (`navigator.webdriver` —
Playwright, an e2e run, the agent browser)? The one definition every browser
beacon stamps its signals with (slow-ops' reports, the latency ledger's
interactions), so an automated browser is **marked, never muted**: it runs the
code a visitor does, and what it does is judged like any other client.
